title: Crazy train - The Prophet parapara dance tutorial (mirrored)

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher presents the dance through a series of repetitive, mirrored video segments. Each segment focuses on a specific part of the choreography, allowing the viewer to learn by following along.

lesson_structure.note: The video introduces the song and the dance.
The video is divided into parts, each showing a specific section of the dance.
The teacher performs the dance in a mirrored format, repeating each part multiple times at different speeds.

steps_taught.name: Para Para basic steps
steps_taught.description: A series of arm and leg movements performed in a specific sequence to the music.

what_works: The mirrored format makes it easy to follow the movements.
The division into parts and the use of different speeds help in learning the choreography.
what_hinders: The lack of verbal explanation or breakdown of the steps might make it difficult for absolute beginners to understand the technique.
